provenance.source: PR #3936 refactor(pattern-router): reduce bundle size and remove outdated comments, squash-merged 2025-02-21
provenance.note: a pattern whose path ends with a wildcard is compiled with an empty suffix, so the route has no end anchor and matches every path that merely shares its prefix: /path/* answers /pathfoo and /paths, and the suffix form /assets* answers /asset; the base built the same expression outside its try block, so this refactor moved the line into the try without giving it a boundary (fix PR #5252)

keywords: matches a path it should not
bugs.note: endsWithWildcard drops the '/?$' suffix instead of requiring 'the end or a slash', so the added pattern line matches a sibling path; the fix compiles '(?:$|/)' for a trailing '/*' and leaves the suffix form unanchored only on the right, which is what a suffix wildcard means
